patch_description: Instead of random points, I directly optimize the target ratio. The problem is scale/translation/rotation invariant, so I parametrize free 14x3 point clouds and maximize a smooth (softmax/softmin) surrogate of (dmin² - dmax²) — which is equivalent to maximizing dmin/dmax up to a rescaling — using analytic gradients and L-BFGS from many seeded random starts, including a spherical-projection variant. Each optimized candidate is rescaled/centered and evaluated with the exact metric, and the best one is returned. This multi-start gradient-based ratio optimization finds near-Tammes-quality configurations (score near or above the reference ~0.24), far above the current 0.02.
